description: One composition exported as a Lottie animation (the open JSON animation format of the Lottie Animation Community, lottie.github.io). Derived (`measured`) from the composition and its layers; a second master for players that read Lottie. This schema constrains only the outermost keys; the format itself is NOT defined in this package, and nothing of the document depends on this node.

layers.description: The layers, as Lottie defines them.

title: core.motion.lottie
